map.出血/围手术期按体重与目标活性算单次因子剂量（IU）: For bleeding / peri-operative care, compute the single factor dose (IU) from body weight and target activity.

map.替代剂量(IU)=体重(kg)×目标差值(%)×系数（FVIII 0.5、FIX: Replacement dose (IU) = body weight (kg) × target difference (%) × factor (FVIII 0.5, FIX 1.0), rounded to 10 IU. Logic: 1 IU/kg FVIII raises activity ~2%, FIX ~1%; so the amount to reach target = weight × difference / rise per IU/kg. Expected peak = current + round(dose / weight / rise per IU/kg).
Example (weight 70 kg, current 1%, joint bleeding target 40%): FVIII factor 0.5, dose = 70×(40-1)×0.5 = 1365 → rounded 1370 IU (19.6 IU/kg); expected peak = 1 + round(1370/70/2) = 1 + 10 = 11%. A single dose reaches the joint bleeding target (30-50%); dose every 8-12 h by FVIII half-life.
map.为什么 FIX 系数是 FVIII 的 2 倍？: Why is the FIX factor twice that of FVIII?
map.因 1 IU/kg FIX 仅提升活性约 1%（FVIII 约 2%），达到同等: Because 1 IU/kg FIX raises activity by only ~1% (FVIII ~2%), reaching the same difference needs about twice the IU/kg; FIX also has a longer half-life and different distribution, so clinically it is dosed less often.
map.剂量很大就安全吗？: Is a very large dose safe?
map.不一定。若存在抑制物，加大因子剂量无效甚至促敏，应改用旁路制剂（rFVIIa/A: Not necessarily. If an inhibitor is present, increasing the factor dose is ineffective and may even sensitize; switch to bypassing agents (rFVIIa/APCC) and consider immune tolerance induction (ITI). For a single dose above 3000 IU, confirm recovery too.
